value.loc: Sec 1, p.1 (term used); checked Sec 1 Introduction, Sec 2 Preliminaries, Sec 3 Matching Elections, Conclusion
value.quote: dichotomous (i.e., approval/disapproval) preferences over each other
value.note: The term is glossed only as approval/disapproval with an informal example (students they like or deemed compatible); the happiness score h_a(W) is a measure over committees derived from approvals, not a statement of what the two classes represent in utility or richer-preference terms, and C4.2 offers no IMPLICIT code.

C4.2.reason: The paper uses 'dichotomous preferences' but never states what approval/disapproval represent in utility or richer-preference terms; the happiness score only counts approved committee members, which at most implies a 0/1 utility and is not said in words.
